title: The holiday party dance
old_caption: Libra spent the whole 2016 party glued to a wall, holding cocoa like a shield. In 2026 it asked someone to dance and warned them it was bad at it. Both were. Nobody cared.

title: The holiday text
old_caption: In 2016 the crush got the same happy holidays text as two hundred other people. In 2026 they got one message about a walk in the first snow, and replied in a second. Who gets your one text?

title: The countdown
old_caption: 2016 Leo counted down to midnight alone, refreshing a chat that never answered. 2026 Leo was so busy talking on a rooftop it looked up at 12:03. Best midnight ever missed.

title: The holiday sweater
old_caption: Matching itchy sweaters for the photo in 2016: one smile, one frown. In 2026 a handmade one with a sleeve that drags on the floor, and Capricorn wears it everywhere. Love is not symmetrical.

title: Whose family?
old_caption: 2016 was the holiday tug-of-war: two dinners, two desserts, late to both. 2026 is a sticky note on the fridge with lunch, dinner and a walk home that belongs to just you two. How do you split the day?

title: The snow day
old_caption: Aquarius watched the 2016 snow day through the window and texted cute snow. In 2026 it went out and helped build the most lopsided snow-star on the block. Cold hands. Totally worth it.

title: The holiday wish
old_caption: Pisces made one wish at the window in 2016: someone to spend the holidays with. Ten years later the table is full, the same star winks back, and yes, Pisces is crying again. Who is at your table this year?

title: Aries Has One Second
old_caption:
Call or text? One second to pick. Aries never hesitates, until the card says sorry first.
Fast at everything. Even apologies.

title: Taurus Won't Let Go
old_caption:
Missing someone at 11 p.m. and the phone is right there?
Taurus put the ex card down and texted a friend instead.

title: Gemini, Pick One
old_caption:
Can you pick just one? Gemini tried. Twice.
When it counts, the honest answer is the only one you need.
